name: vamp-mcp-tools
displayName: VAMP MCP Tools — VM Automation & Vault
description: Packer-powered VM setup, post-install automation and golden image management over MCP. Includes VM GUI automation and VAMP Vault.

commands.title: VAMP: Verify Python Environment (Activation and Imports)
VAMP: Remote · Prepare Environment on the Remote Host
VAMP: Remote · Set Host and User

vamp.podman.desktopImageIds.description: Verified immutable IDs of VAMP desktop images allowed for container screen viewing and capture. Leave empty to disable screen access. Do not trust an image ID based only on a tag or a label.

vamp.pythonExecutable.description: Optional host Python executable path. Otherwise detect Python 3 automatically.

vamp.mousePythonExecutable.description: Optional host Python with VirtualBox SDK vboxapi for mouse input.

vamp.kvmRepositoryPath.description: Local VAMP repository containing vm_mcp_server.py. KVM uses the shared VNC display.

vamp.kvmPythonExecutable.description: KVM MCP Python with requirements-mcp.txt installed. Defaults to the repository .venv.

vamp.kvmConfigPath.description: Optional VM profile JSON for the KVM MCP server. Defaults to config/vm-mcp.json in the repository.

vamp.libvirtUri.description: Local KVM connection used by VM Manager. Session runs VMs as your user; system requires libvirt permissions.

vamp.rpaDirectories.description: Additional host folders containing VM recordings or RPA packages. You can also add them from RPA Library.

vamp.remote.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the **VAMP Remote (SSH)** server and remote desktop manager. The remote host runs the VAMP remote server and keeps its own hypervisor and guest credentials.

vamp.remote.host.description: Host name or address of the machine that runs the virtual desktops (LAN, VPN or Tailscale name).

vamp.remote.port.description: SSH port on the remote host.

vamp.remote.username.description: SSH user on the remote host. Leave empty to use your local user name.

vamp.remote.privateKeyPath.description: Optional private key file. Leave empty to use your SSH agent and ~/.ssh configuration.

enumDescriptions: KVM / QEMU through libvirt (virsh) on a Linux host.
VirtualBox through VBoxManage on a Linux, Windows or macOS host.
vamp.remote.backend.description: Hypervisor that the remote host manages.

vamp.remote.libvirtUri.description: libvirt connection used on the remote host, for example qemu:///system or qemu+ssh://user@host/system.

vamp.remote.remotePythonPath.description: Python 3.11+ on the remote host, used to replay saved RPAs.

vamp.remote.remoteNodePath.description: Node.js 20+ on the remote host. The remote MCP server runs on it.

vamp.remote.remoteRepoPath.description: Optional VAMP checkout on the remote host. Needed only to replay saved RPAs.

vamp.remote.remoteRegistryPath.description: Optional saved RPA registry folder on the remote host. Defaults to ~/.vamp/remote/rpa-catalog.

vamp.remote.remoteVboxManagePath.description: Optional VBoxManage path on the remote host when it is not on PATH.

vamp.remote.connectTimeoutSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for the SSH connection before reporting a failure.

vamp.podman.workspaceConfigPath.description: Absolute path to an owner-controlled mode 0600 workspace JSON configuration for local Linux only. Attaches an already-unlocked VeraCrypt workspace to a new disposable desktop after explicit confirmation. Never unlocks volumes. Workspace-folder settings are ignored. Empty uses trusted VAMP_WORKSPACE_CONFIG environment.
